# Code of Conduct

PiHoleShell follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful and constructive in issues, pull requests and discussions. Harassment, personal attacks, insulting or discriminatory comments, and publishing someone's private information aren't tolerated.

## Reporting

If someone's behaviour breaks this code, report it privately through the repository's [Security tab](https://github.com/mikemadeja/PiHoleShell/security) using **Report a vulnerability**, and say in the title that it's a conduct report. Only the maintainer can see it. Reports are kept confidential.

## Enforcement

The maintainer reviews every report and may edit or remove comments, close or lock threads, or block people from the project, depending on how serious the behaviour is. The Contributor Covenant's [enforcement guidelines](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/#enforcement-guidelines) are followed.
